## Solo Developer Notes

**Feature Request Process**:
- I review all feature requests
- Feasibility assessment based on architecture and roadmap
- Alignment with Kurikulum Merdeka domain requirements
- Priority based on community impact and technical feasibility

**What I'm Looking For**:
- Clear problem statement and user impact
- Alignment with educational workflows
- Technical feasibility within DDD Lite architecture
- Reasonable implementation complexity for solo maintainer

**What Might Be Declined**:
- Features requiring CQRS/Event Sourcing (architecture freeze)
- New domains outside Kurikulum Merdeka scope
- Features requiring significant architectural changes
- Very complex features not feasible for solo development

**Timeline Notes**:
- No guaranteed timelines (solo developer with other commitments)
- Roadmap priority may change based on community feedback
- High-priority features from community may jump queue

Thank you for suggesting improvements to NUSA Platform! 💡
